item.title: Lawmakers say U.S. military used laser to take down Border Protection drone
item.description: FORT HANCOCK, Texas — The U.S. military used a laser to shoot down a Customs and Border Protection drone, members of Congress said Thursday, and the Federal Aviation Administration responded by closing more airspace near El Paso, Texas.

item.title: Ancient coupling may have happened more between human females and Neanderthal males
item.description: NEW YORK — Humans and Neanderthals cozied up from time to time when they lived in the same areas tens of thousands of years ago. But we don’t know much about who got with whom, or why.
